I need the top 5 candidates and I have about an hour of compute to spend on docking. Use the budget well.
Find some good candidates cheaply. I'm screening many candidate sets and cannot spend much compute on any one of them.
I need to recover at least 8 of the true top-10 binders by docking score. Spend whatever docking budget that takes.
Give me a solid shortlist with a reasonable amount of compute -- nothing extreme in either direction.
Quick exploratory look. I just want a rough sense of which few molecules are worth a closer look later. Keep compute to a minimum.
